name: Telegram Notification Channel
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: Route McHarbor workflow, alert, and backup events to a Telegram chat via the Bot API (https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/...). Create a bot with @BotFather, drop the bot_token + chat_id into the channel form, and the plugin handles Test (getMe liveness) + Send (sendMessage). Supports Markdown / HTML parse_mode and silent sends for low-priority alerts. Adds the channels:use-comm-telegram permission so operators can grant 'send alerts via this channel' as a discrete, auditable capability.
